verdict_detail: Strong, honest recommender DECISION dossier (not a pile of components), but with a real component-coherence + OPE-logging gap. Proceed via G26A (architecture consolidation + OPE logging design) then G26B (unblock the built G26 mitigation). V1 stays gold_candidate 8.9, untouched.
top_15_claim_risks: V1 d3aplus R@20 0.0846 vs served c2 ~0.0375 recall not reconciled in one place — interview trap.
G20 SASRec headline is plot_reconstructed (secondary metrics lost) — packaging gap blocking gold_complete.
No confidence intervals on any headline metric.
Recall is single-held-out-gold; NDCG not computed (could be challenged).
All behavioural claims have NO online evidence (offline only).
Heuristic G26 rerankers could be mistaken for a learned LTR ranker.
Head-cap Pareto win is protocol-specific (warm cohort, niche-skewed gold) — must not be stated as universal.
Popularity fallback could be mis-sold as a healthy default (it is Gini 1.0, emergency-only).
Exposure audit could be mis-stated as fairness — must stay 'concentration', not certification.
Item cold-start (57.2%) must stay 'offline-split unseen', not real new-catalog cold-start.
Local TestClient p95 (~3.3ms) is not production p95.
HNSW must stay explicit scale option, not silent default.
FAISS speedups are latency, not quality — easy to overstate.
OPE (IPS/SNIPS/DR) is invalid until propensities are logged — must not report any OPE number yet.
G24/G25/G26 absolute numbers are SERVED_MODEL c2 and NOT_COMPARABLE_ACROSS_PROTOCOLS to V1.

No learned reranker (LambdaMART/LTR) implemented — G26 rerankers are heuristic.
No creator-side/business metadata exploited (creator exposure blind).
No real new-item cold-start launch simulation.
No reconciled model/index registry (d3aplus vs c2).

A valid IPS/SNIPS/DR estimate once logged.

safe_claims_now: Built an offline, honesty-gated two-stage recommender decision program on a real 2.56M-interaction Goodreads catalog.
Tuned ALS to a warm retrieval floor and showed a canonical full-softmax SASRec, trained to convergence, still lost — MF is the warm floor under this protocol.
Diagnosed candidate coverage as the binding bottleneck and lifted offline recall ~44% by widening candidate generation.
Built a FAISS latency-quality frontier: FlatIP exact lossless ~47% faster; HNSW ef64 near-lossless (overlap 0.992) ~2.4x; rejected IVF for candidate-overlap collapse.
Built and load-tested a production-like FastAPI serving API with versioned loader, full fallback tree, structured logging, health and monitoring hooks (warm p95 ~3.3ms local, 0% empty).
Measured cold/sparse fallback QUALITY: popularity fallback collapses catalog coverage ~59x and personalization to ~0; reported recall non-monotonicity honestly.
Audited catalog exposure concentration (Gini, coverage, zero-exposure, head/tail lift) and showed HNSW is exposure-neutral vs exact.
Built exposure-aware rerankers and quantified the relevance/exposure tradeoff frontier (head-cap Pareto-dominant on the warm cohort; MMR/genre-div honest negatives).
safe_claims_after_next_gate: Consolidated a single recommender decision architecture (candgen->retrieval->rank/rerank->fallback->serve->log->evaluate->decide) with a reconciled model/index registry.
Designed a propensity-logging schema that makes IPS/SNIPS/DR off-policy evaluation valid.
Produced an online-experiment-readiness card for an exposure-mitigation rollout.
(G26B) Wired a head-cap/tail-boost exposure mitigation into the serving path with a measured relevance/exposure tradeoff.

G26A directly unlocks OPE/mitigation execution, satisfying the 'no audit-only gate unless it unlocks OPE/mitigation' bar; G26 work loses nothing by shipping as G26B on a consolidated spine.
